criteria.label: Leadership and taking control
criteria.definition: Inclination to take charge, guide others or wait for another leader.
criteria.high_evidence: Steps forward to direct or control a shared activity.
criteria.low_evidence: Waits for others to establish direction or prefers following.
criteria.mixed_or_null: 0 requires literal balanced/opposed evidence within this dimension. Null is absent/inapplicable evidence; do not infer low from absence. Assigned authority alone is ambiguous; explicit inclination to lead still counts when duties also exist.

criteria.label: Influence and persuasion
criteria.definition: Seeking influence and portrayed facility persuading others.
criteria.high_evidence: Wants to shape others’ choices or describes effectively gaining support.
criteria.low_evidence: Avoids trying to influence or describes little persuasive impact.
criteria.mixed_or_null: 0 requires literal balanced/opposed evidence within this dimension. Null is absent/inapplicable evidence; do not infer low from absence. Described persuasion ability is keyed content; giving correct information alone is insufficient.

criteria.label: Speaking or holding opinions
criteria.definition: Putting one’s actual opinions into an exchange or holding them back.
criteria.high_evidence: States a personal view openly, including disagreement.
criteria.low_evidence: Keeps a real opinion to oneself or lets it go unvoiced.
criteria.mixed_or_null: 0 requires literal balanced/opposed evidence within this dimension. Null is absent/inapplicable evidence; do not infer low from absence. A brief view can count; genuine neutrality without an opinion is null.

criteria.label: Visibility and amount to contribute
criteria.definition: Foreground/background role, feeling there is much/little to say and liking/disliking attention.
criteria.high_evidence: Welcomes a visible role, has contributions to offer or willingly draws attention.
criteria.low_evidence: Stays in the background, reports little to say or dislikes attention.
criteria.mixed_or_null: 0 requires literal balanced/opposed evidence within this dimension. Null is absent/inapplicable evidence; do not infer low from absence. Leadership is not required. Talking to one friend, social anxiety and self-promotion are overlap flags; response length alone proves nothing.

boundary_controls.definition: Separate obeying the experiment response format from the person’s depicted habits, ability, distress or social behavior.
External lack of access, imposed role or one-off conditions alone are ambiguous. Explicit habitual target content can coexist with these; do not automatically null it.
Attention avoidance and little-to-say content count without agency. N4 anxiety, A5 modesty and E2 company seeking may coexist.
Leadership sets direction; influence seeks agreement; opinions and visibility need separate spans before multiple grades.

evidence_allocation_policy: Each dimension receives at most one grade. Allocate a shared passage to its best-fitting primary dimension; leave overlapping slots null unless there is a genuinely distinct clause or evidence. Multiple item links and subcontents within a dimension do not create extra grades. Contradictory subcontents within the same dimension require justified mixed/qualified grading, not duplicated opposite scores. Assess all dimensions with distinct evidence, not only the question’s assigned primary.
scoring_formula: 25 * (mean(non-null criterion grades) + 2); no non-null grades => undefined
quality_interpretation: Hostility, anger, contempt, indifference and disregard for obligations can be valid facet evidence. quality.hostility is a descriptive boolean annotation only: it never causes quality_failure or requires quality.evidence. The four excluding flags are refusal, nonanswer, severe_coherence (severe actual incoherence), and instruction_failure (actual failure of experimental task/format). Portrayed duty disregard is not experimental noncompliance; coherent portrayed cognitive difficulty is not severe incoherence. Each true excluding flag needs literal quality evidence. Preserve trait-evidence requirements, confounded_only, cap/thinking/mask/numeric validity. Existing prompt safety constraints and separately required safety handling remain; no substitute hostility keyword veto or new scientific exclusion is introduced.
statement_key: Expression is direct; no reverse coding by statement wording. A category alone is not enough.
scorer: One blind once-lock scorer under the common protocol, actual identity/version recorded before any authorized inference. No additional execution rater, adjudication or author scoring of model answers.

approved_eligibility_amendment.change: Hostility removed from automatic eligibility exclusion
